title: Niger calculator readiness research — Batch 33
executive_summary: Extracted official INS/DS-MAGEL 2024 national crop production, sown-area and selected yield series, herd inventory context, and current eight-region administrative structure. SIMA weekly regional market and fertilizer exports are identified, but exact producer-price classifications and farmer-paid costs remain to be verified. Niger remains directory-only.

administrative_geography.source: INS Tableau de Bord Social 2025, law No. 2011-22; the proposed 19-region reorganisation is not applied pending legal implementation.

national_crop_observations_2024.source_unit: production and area reported in thousand tonnes/thousand hectares; yield in kg/ha
national_crop_observations_2024.scope: national aggregate; do not use as region-specific calculator yield
national aggregate; do not use as region-specific calculator yield
paddy basis; do not treat as milled rice
national aggregate; production value not directly tabled in extracted series; separate 5-year mean is 2,412,787.4 t, not a 2024 observation
2024 statistical-year series; separate RECA 2024/25 campaign observation is 2,163,211 t on 62,500 ha; do not combine periods

livestock_inventory_2024.source: INS TBS 2025 executive key indicators; herd inventory, not saleable production or output

market_evidence.SIMA: Weekly prices by market, region and product; regional means; CSV/Excel export; fertilizer series. Do not treat as farm-gate until the price level, date, grade, market and unit are explicitly verified.

onion_2024_25_campaign.source: RECA report published March 2026; separate from INS 2024 annual statistical series.

safeguards: National yields are not assigned to regions.
The five-year mean cowpea production is not labelled as 2024 output.
The two onion reporting periods remain distinct.
SIMA market/sack prices are not converted to per-kg or called farm-gate without verified sack weights and price-level metadata.
No original active country profile has been changed.

remaining_work: Extract and validate regional crop output, harvested area and yield for the 17 supported calculator commodities; national averages are insufficient.
Download SIMA weekly and regional CSV/Excel series and identify true producer/farm-gate observations, product grade, sack weights and units.
Extract SIMA fertilizer series with exact product, bag size, market, date and unit; obtain seed, crop-protection, irrigation/energy, labour and machinery quotations.
Build regional budgets by irrigated/rainfed production system and include onion, cowpea, rice and supported crops only where commodity mapping is correct.
Obtain livestock offtake, liveweight/auction prices, feed, veterinary, mortality and enterprise cost data.
Map validated evidence to calculator schema and add country/regional test cases; no activation until tests pass.
